name: bx-agents-runtime-libs
shortDescription: ColdBox runtime libraries bundled into the BX Agents module as lib/ and copied into every generated app. Installed at BUILD time by `./gradlew installLibs` (CommandBox / the bx-cli module), never by users. The ONE manifest for every library the module, its tests and its generated apps use: dependencies ship; devDependencies (TestBox) stay on the developer's machine.
